psychology.text: Stop the scroll in 3 seconds — one question in the viewer's mind with a promised payoff
Pattern interrupt triggers orienting response — brain notices movement, intense emotion, sudden contrast
Curiosity loop / information gap — text teases without resolving; viewer needs completion
Loss aversion — tease a mistake, secret, or costly miss; FOMO on the reveal
Mute-first: >60% watch without sound — burned text must carry subtext alone
Instant clarity — dense staccato words; specific numbers or objects build trust fast

formulas.name: Promise or Curiosity Hook
formulas.template: [3-8 word title] (makes a promise or teases curiosity)
examples: Whole Foods has gotten SHADIER than ever 😳
PSYCHOLOGIST EXPLAINS HOW TO STOP FEELING EXHAUSTED 😩
How To Fix Shoulder Blade Pain

formulas.name: Promise or Curiosity Teaser
formulas.template: [3-8 words] that makes a promise or teases curiosity.
examples: Whole Foods has gotten SHADIER than ever
PSYCHOLOGIST EXPLAINS HOW TO STOP FEELING EXHAUSTED
How To Fix Shoulder Blade Pain
developers don't even need a keyboard anymore

formulas.name: Promise or Curiosity
examples: How To Fix Shoulder Blade Pain

formulas.name: Contrarian (Counterintuitive Truth)
formulas.template: Why [Common Belief] is actually hurting your [Desired Outcome]
examples: Posting daily kills engagement
Cardio prevents weight loss

formulas.name: Fortune Teller (Secret Reveal)
formulas.template: [Number] secrets [Authority Figure] doesn't want you to know
examples: 3 YouTube secrets Mr. Beast hides
5 contractor secrets stores hide

formulas.name: Result Preview (Transformation Tease)
formulas.template: How I went from [Bad Situation] to [Good Situation] in [Timeframe]
examples: 10 leads to 1000 in 90 days
2 home sales to 50 yearly

twitch_comp_adaptations: Burned hook = TEXT layer only — visual interrupt comes from the clip itself; text adds curiosity gap
3–6 words ideal on screen; hard max 12 words / 72 chars
Anchor every hook to one concrete noun from Gemini observation (object, action, quoted detail)
Question marks and contrast words boost scroll-stop when observation supports a twist
Never name the streamer — moment beat only

Focus on scroll-stopping text that immediately conveys value or intrigue, as the viewer's attention span is extremely short on platforms like YouTube Shorts/Twitch clips.
**Mute-First Priority:** For Twitch reaction clips, the burned text hook is paramount as viewers often scroll with sound off. It must work independently of audio.

**Visual-Text Synergy:** The burned text must immediately clarify or amplify the visual action/emotion (e.g., streamer's reaction, game event) to create instant curiosity or a clear promise without sound.
**Conciseness is Key:** Adhere strictly to the 3-8 word limit for maximum readability and quick comprehension on a small screen.
**Emotional/Curiosity Triggers:** Use words that evoke strong emotions, pose a question, or hint at a surprising outcome to encourage unmuting and continued viewing.
**Contextual Relevance:** The burned text should leverage the visual context of the reaction clip (e.g., streamer's expression, specific game moment) to make immediate sense and be impactful.
For mute-first Twitch reaction clips, the burned text hook is even more critical as it often serves as the primary initial engagement point.

The 'visual hook' for a reaction clip is the streamer's reaction itself. The text hook must complement this, creating an information gap about *what* the streamer is reacting to, or *why* their reaction is significant.
Since verbal context might be absent or delayed (due to mute-first viewing), the text hook must be self-sufficient in generating curiosity.
Prioritize the 'teases curiosity' aspect of the hook formula to avoid spoiling the clip's core moment or the reason for the reaction.
Utilize emojis within the 3-8 word limit to quickly convey emotion, tone, or amplify the information gap, as they are highly effective in a visual-first, text-burned format.
For mute-first burned captions, hooks must be visually striking and immediately comprehensible.
